scope: Read-only source audit; no product source edits and no user content scans. Line numbers refer to pre-implementation source on 2026-09-25.

findings.observation: All roots including project archives are enumerated before any basic asset is inspected, and GUI receives only a final report.
findings.cost: First useful inventory latency equals all discovery + all parsing + matching.
findings.recommendation: Construct basic assets during discovery, emit throttled immutable inventory snapshots, and start project discovery/parsing after inventory; show background enrichment explicitly.

findings.observation: visibleAssets rebuilds inclusion-date dictionary, filters and sorts every access; selectedAsset invokes it even for nil selection; inspector/detail repeat it.
findings.cost: Up to three O(N log N) localized sorts per refresh and multiple sorts per row selection on main actor.
findings.recommendation: Cache filtered/sorted rows keyed by report revision/category/query/sort; obtain selection directly from path index. Build sample-inclusion dictionary once per report; avoid full refresh for pure progress.

findings.observation: Each directory accumulates and sorts all children before visiting first child, comparing repeated URL.path properties.
findings.cost: O(k log k) work and k child allocations per directory delaying first result; deterministic traversal currently defines truncation subset.
findings.recommendation: Stream children, cache path strings, and sort presentation once; preserve cap reporting and document filesystem-order selection if limit truncates.

findings.observation: Bundle-ID metadata reads and complete project parsing are serialized in same candidate queue as cheap sample/file attributes.
findings.cost: Thousands of plugin Info.plist opens, then each project input up to32MiB decoded64MiB; all on first result critical path.
findings.recommendation: Publish basic identity/name/format/size first; enrich plugin IDs and project reports afterward. Consider bounded small concurrency only after storage benchmarks; never unbounded task per path.

findings.observation: Every plugin plist and project repeats rootward symlink metadata checks; Logic repeats traversal for metadata.
findings.cost: O(number of candidates × path depth) potential filesystem metadata lookups, including unsupported projects.
findings.recommendation: Keep checks until a measured safe descriptor-relative traversal replaces them; naive shared ancestor cache can weaken safety if symlink changes.

findings.observation: Progress output is throttled, but caller creates url.path and publish reads Date even when 250ms throttle drops notification.
findings.cost: Per-entry overhead on large trees; already separate progress-only GUI callback avoids table reload.
findings.recommendation: Throttle cheap counter before materializing paths when feasible; maintain phase/sequence ordering and forced terminal update.

findings.observation: No cancellation or time-budget checks; detached synchronous scan continues until bounded entry/depth completion.
findings.cost: Entry/byte bounds do not imply wall-clock deadline on external/disconnected/cloud storage.
findings.recommendation: Cooperative cancellation and a soft foreground budget; present partial browseable inventory and ongoing background discovery before60s. Explicitly report a stalled OS call cannot be forcibly bounded by this synchronous API.

findings.observation: Reference matching already builds dictionary indexed by exact resolved path and deduplicates project paths.
findings.cost: Approximately linear references + samples; not an N×M nested-match hotspot.
findings.recommendation: Preserve exact matching and unresolved-path exclusions. Intermediate snapshots must say not checked, never no references found.

measurement: scanner-baseline.json: synthetic local debug CLI; does not measure GUI or external storage.
recommended_acceptance: First nonempty inventory publication precedes any project-file parsing.
Intermediate report coverage explicitly pending; final coverage remains partial/unsupported/failed as appropriate.
Browsing and selection remain responsive during background analysis; throttled progress does not trigger row rebuild.
Synthetic large collection shows first usable inventory in <60s; actual external-storage latency is separately measured, never promised universally.
Symlink, package exclusions, regular-file validation, parser/entry/depth caps and immutability regressions pass.
benchmark_gaps: Need stage durations and first-inventory callback timing with final implementation.
Need large-window GUI refresh/selection timing; source establishes repeated sorting but no profiler distribution measured.
Need permission-conscious bounded real storage test to quantify external/cloud latency.
Do not claim a speedup factor from source inspection alone.
